newsitem.title: USA: U.S. stocks seen opening higher.
newsitem.headline: U.S. stocks seen opening higher.

text.p: Wall Street stocks are expected to head higher at the start of trading Monday.
Analysts said that the market could see a reversal either later today or tomorrow before taking off on a summer rally.

"I think we will have a blowout either later in the session today or tomorrow," said Peter Cardillo, director of research at Westfalia Investments. "The market has come up a long way, and everyone is positive. I think we'll get into record territory and then meet some resistance."
